about: u1 is approved on round 0; u2 gets fix on rounds 0, 1, and 2. On each fix round the migrator rewrites u2 in the record and its copy in idea-mara, and leaves u1 alone. Each re-check's cut-down record holds u2 only, with the three lists empty, though the record still has entries in them. After round 2's fix, u2 is undone from the round 2 record: its round 2 copy line is removed, so idea-mara is back to its start. u1's copy in idea-tobias stays. The unit index has b1-u1 approved, then b1-u2 undone. One batch, so the run ends at batches-done.
readings: After batches-done, round is 0 (CONTRACT.md 5.3 item 8, last bullet).
